messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — need final take on long-term routing & multi-region isolation. Customers pushing for guarantees.
Ajay Singh: Core tradeoff: strict tenant fencing vs utilization. Some will need cryptographic separation.
Nora Chen: Proposal: Launch path A = regional isolation (soft isolation, strong telemetry). Path B = full fencing (dedicated pools).
Maya Patel: For Path A launch criteria: canary plan (1%, 5%, 10%), documented failure modes, per-tenant SLO baselines, evacuation playbook.
Samir Rao: Infra: implement as isolation flag on current fabric for Path A. Need eviction policy, capacity gating, and auto-evac.
Ajay Singh: Ops: rollout sequence: dev -> internal beta (2 customers) -> staged canaries -> GA. Fallback: route to compatible model variant in alternate region.
Nora Chen: Customer asks: per-tenant bandwidth caps, geo-locking region pinning, and exportable audit logs. Compliance will require dedicated pools for some customers.
Maya Patel: Decision: default = shared pools with strict quotas; dedicated capacity on request after compliance review. Telemetry reqs: token-level latency percentiles, per-route error budgets.
Samir Rao: KV cache note: shared cache thrashes on long contexts. Path A: enforce per-tenant cache quotas and eviction priority. Need experiments.
Ajay Singh: Sizing: Samir to run cache/quota sims; Nora to collect priority customer list and redlines; Maya to draft launch criteria doc.
Maya Patel: Timeline: draft by EOD Friday; internal beta mid-July. Please ack and list blockers. :thumbsup: 
Ajay Singh: ack.
Nora Chen: ack, pinging compliance this afternoon.
Samir Rao: ack, posting sims here when done.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: started canary "routing-pathA-canary" at 1751240120.
